releases.title: Early Access is live
releases.summary: Football Arcade opens with Era XI, persistent player profiles, competitive weekly boards, and more ways to share every impossible season.
releases.label: latest

New: Play Era XI from the first draw through a full historical league season and final team review.
Continue as a guest or link a Google or email account to keep verified runs and progress.
Send feedback from inside Football Arcade to help shape Early Access.
Improved: Phone and tablet layouts now make the full Early Access experience easier to navigate.
Fixed: Saved results, leaderboard entries, and account progress are more reliable.

releases.title: Make your run count
releases.summary: Your best Era XI stories can now live beyond the final whistle through achievements, weekly competition, and downloadable cards.
releases.label: major update

New: Unlock achievements and build lifetime statistics from verified Era XI campaigns.
Enter weekly era leaderboards and revisit results from previous weeks.
Download share cards for squads and account milestones.
Improved: Guest progress can be linked to an account without losing the runs already played.
Fixed: Achievement saves, authentication callbacks, and leaderboard records are more reliable.

releases.title: Era XI finds its rhythm
releases.summary: The live mode received a deeper football world, clearer squad building, and a more balanced journey from draft to season review.

New: Build an XI across five football eras, then pair it with a manager and historical league season.
Inspect player profiles, position fit, playstyle tags, partnerships, and club-core chemistry before committing.
Improved: Era fit, positional ratings, rerolls, formations, match replays, and season awards were rebalanced for clearer choices.
Data: The player pool and historical season database expanded, with club and career details corrected along the way.
